scope: D3.2 finance history visibility and request lifecycle
behavior: Receivables entry, hidden history filter changes and hidden-history payment completion make zero ledger calls.
Opening or reopening history explicitly requests one fresh first page with includeSummary=false; subsequent pages are requested only by Load more.
Closing history, changing its filter, unmounting or changing account/authority fences late success, errors and legacy type fallback.
The receivables refresh button now refreshes its contract/student directory; it reads the ledger only while history is open.
History loading/error/retry states appear inside the dialog. Failed history is never presented as an empty successful ledger.
Existing global debt and installment totals continue to use the complete authorized contract directory, independently of loaded ledger pages.

validation.browserRunDetails: Initial run passed14/18; four filter cases used an incorrect CSS selector. Those four passed after switching to the observed accessible combobox label. Production implementation was unchanged between runs.

remaining: Finance directory cursor pagination with separately authoritative complete debt totals.
